slides.heading: Longest Most Frequent Prefix
slides.subtitle: AlgoExpert · Hard · Tries
slides.narration: Let's solve Longest Most Frequent Prefix, a hard tries problem. We'll restate the problem, build the intuition, walk through the approach, read the Java solution, and finish with its complexity.

slides.heading: The problem
bullets: Given unique strings, return the prefix shared by the most strings; ties go to the longest such prefix.
slides.narration: Here's the problem. Given unique strings, return the prefix shared by the most strings; ties go to the longest such prefix. Trie storing per-node counts.

slides.heading: Intuition
bullets: A trie with counts at each node gives every prefix's frequency directly.
slides.narration: A trie with counts at each node gives every prefix's frequency directly.

slides.heading: Brute force vs optimal
bullets: Count all prefixes in a hash map → O(total chars²) strings
slides.narration: Counting every prefix as a separate string costs quadratic memory. A trie with counts does it in total characters.

slides.heading: Approach
bullets: 1. Insert strings counting passes per node
2. Track the max count and longest depth
slides.narration: Step by step. First, insert strings counting passes per node. Second, track the max count and longest depth. Third, return that prefix.

slides.caption: Insert words into a trie with prefix counts

slides.heading: Java solution
slides.narration: We insert each string, incrementing counts. Then we walk each string again, updating the best when a node's count is higher, or equal with a longer prefix.

slides.heading: Complexity
slides.narration: Time is O of n times m. Space is O of n times m.

slides.heading: Edge cases & pitfalls
slides.narration: On ties in count, prefer the longer prefix.

slides.heading: Recap
bullets: A trie with counts at each node gives every prefix's frequency directly.
slides.narration: To recap Longest Most Frequent Prefix: A trie with counts at each node gives every prefix's frequency directly. Try re-implementing it from scratch without looking.
